args.message:
Fix money.py to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The round_money() docstring already specified banker's rounding
(ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but the implementation incorrectly
used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly build's test_money.py to
fail. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN to fix the failing test.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py` documented banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212) but the implementation used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build to fail in `tests/test_money.py`.

## Changes
- Import `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.
- Use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `amount.quantize(Decimal("0.01"), ...)`.

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding` (commit `08d3cd5986`) passed.

Fixes the failing nightly build.
